name: big-knowledge-graph
description: A Khoj cluster deployment for personal knowledge management and AI-powered search

scripts.restart: npm run stop && npm run start
scripts.restart:minimal: npm run stop:minimal && npm run start:minimal
scripts.clean:minimal: docker-compose -f docker-compose.minimal.yml down -v --remove-orphans && docker system prune -f
scripts.setup: npm run setup:env && npm run pull
scripts.backup: npm run backup:db && npm run backup:config
scripts.backup:db: mkdir -p backups && docker-compose exec -T database pg_dump -U postgres postgres > backups/database-$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).sql
scripts.backup:config: mkdir -p backups && docker cp $(docker-compose ps -q khoj):/root/.khoj backups/khoj-config-$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S) || echo 'Config backup failed (service might not be running)'
